description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between four different data categories—"Tutorials," "Library Documentation," "Github files," and an obscured category—across varying token counts. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Tokens" and features a linear scale ranging from 200 to 1000, with tick marks at regular intervals of 200. The y-axis lacks a specific label but employs a linear scale ranging from 10 to 40, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The "Tutorials" category is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, starting at a value of approximately 23 at 200 tokens, rising to a peak of roughly 29 at 800 tokens, and ending slightly lower at approximately 28.5 at 1000 tokens. The "Library Documentation" category is depicted by a solid red line with circular markers, beginning at approximately 26 at 200 tokens, increasing to a peak of about 32 at 800 tokens, and declining to roughly 27 at 1000 tokens. The "Github files" category is shown as a solid green line with circular markers, starting at approximately 28 at 200 tokens, peaking at about 32.5 at 800 tokens, and decreasing to roughly 30 at 1000 tokens. Finally, the obscured category is represented by a solid yellow line with circular markers, which exhibits a steady decline from a starting high of approximately 33 at 200 tokens, dropping to roughly 19 at 800 tokens, and concluding at its lowest point of approximately 11.5 at 1000 tokens.
